newsitem.title: USA: Reddi Brake holders approve share increase.
newsitem.headline: Reddi Brake holders approve share increase.

text.p: Reddi Brake Supply Corp said its shareholders overwhelmingly approved a proposal to increase the number of authorized common shares to 75 million from 35 million.

The increase makes available sufficient shares of common stock in reserve to meet existing obligations of Reddi Brake and to take advantage of future financing, acquisition or investment activities that may arise, the company said.
Reddi Brake operates 85 Reddi Brake warehouse stores that sell brake systems, chassis components and other auto undercarriage parts to professional installers.
